newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe Steel plans nine bln yen mill refurbishment.
newsitem.headline: Kobe Steel plans nine bln yen mill refurbishment.

text.p: Kobe Steel Ltd said on Monday that it plans to spend roughly nine billion yen to refurbish a wire rod mill in Kobe, western Japan, starting in October.

Kobe Steel plans to install a new finishing mill which is capable of handling high loads at low rolling temperatures. It will also put in a sizing mill to further improve rolling accuracy, a company statement said.
The plan also includes the construction of a vertical warehouse, the statement said.
The company's wire rod mill in Kobe has been operating since 1969. The remodeled line is scheduled to start operating in December 1998, the statement said.
